meta.description: Round robin: every 5 minutes (or on POST watch-now), records each later owner change on leads from the last 30 days (who, when, through what), and adds booking link visits that turned into a booking as that rep's lead. Changes nothing in HubSpot.

parameters.query:
-- Leads to watch for later owner changes: the latest per contact in the last 30 days (from the list or a booking),
-- assigned or kept, with the owner the tool gave it and the name stored for it (kept in step with HubSpot).
SELECT json_build_object('rows', COALESCE(json_agg(x), '[]'::json), 'ids', COALESCE(string_agg(x.contact_id, ','), '')) AS body
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.contact_id) l.id, l.contact_id, l.contact_name, l.owner_id, l.created_at
  FROM cypress_rr_leads l
  WHERE l.created_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND l.status IN ('assigned', 'kept_existing') AND l.owner_id IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY l.contact_id, l.created_at DESC
) x;

WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO cypress_rr_owner_changes (lead_id, contact_id, from_owner_id, to_owner_id, source_type, source_id,
    source_label, changed_by_user_id, changed_at)
  SELECT (x->>'lead_id')::bigint, x->>'contact_id', x->>'from_owner_id', x->>'to_owner_id',
    COALESCE(x->>'source_type', ''), COALESCE(x->>'source_id', ''), COALESCE(x->>'source_label', ''),
    x->>'changed_by_user_id', (x->>'changed_at')::timestamptz
  FROM p, jsonb_array_elements(p.j->'rows') x
  ON CONFLICT (lead_id, changed_at) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
-- names as HubSpot has them now, on every lead of that contact
ren AS (
  UPDATE cypress_rr_leads l SET contact_name = x->>'name'
  FROM p, jsonb_array_elements(p.j->'renames') x
  WHERE l.contact_id = x->>'contact_id' AND l.contact_name IS DISTINCT FROM x->>'name'
  RETURNING l.id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) AS inserted, (SELECT count(*) FROM ren) AS renamed;

-- Booking link visits that may have turned into a booking: sent to the rotation or a boosted rep in the last 2 days,
-- not a lead yet, and their email isn't already an assigned lead (from the list or an earlier booking).
SELECT json_build_object('rows', COALESCE(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.created_at), '[]'::json),
  'emails', COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT x.email, ','), '')) AS body
FROM (
  SELECT v.id, v.email, v.owner_id AS previous_owner_id, v.rep_id, v.rep_name, v.route, v.created_at, r.hs_owner_id
  FROM cypress_rr_visits v JOIN cypress_rr_reps r ON r.id = v.rep_id
  WHERE v.created_at > now() - interval '2 days' AND v.route IN ('rotation', 'boost') AND v.email <> ''
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cypress_rr_leads l WHERE l.visit_id = v.id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cypress_rr_leads l WHERE lower(l.contact_email) = v.email AND l.status = 'assigned')
) x;

-- Each booked visit becomes a lead (source 'booking', at the visit's time). The cypress_rr_lead_counted trigger then
-- counts it like a list lead: a boosted one uses a boosted lead, any other moves the rotation to its rep unless an
-- assigned lead from later is already in. Oldest first, so the latest booking ends up as the pointer.
WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO cypress_rr_leads (source, contact_id, contact_name, contact_email, visit_id, previous_owner_id, owner_id,
    rep_id, rep_name, status, boosted, reason, created_at)
  SELECT 'booking', x->>'contact_id', COALESCE(x->>'contact_name', ''), x->>'email', (x->>'visit_id')::bigint,
    x->>'previous_owner_id', x->>'owner_id', (x->>'rep_id')::int, COALESCE(x->>'rep_name', ''), 'assigned',
    COALESCE((x->>'boosted')::boolean, false),
    'Booked a meeting with ' || COALESCE(x->>'rep_name', 'their rep') || ' through the booking link.',
    (x->>'visited_at')::timestamptz
  FROM p, jsonb_array_elements(p.j->'rows') x
  ORDER BY (x->>'visited_at')::timestamptz
  ON CONFLICT (visit_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT count(*) AS booked FROM ins;
